content:
helena: heads-up from our SI: they want a short maintenance window to pin a GPU driver and verify perf regressions. goal: reversible in <30m, low customer impact
omar: okay — which driver/cuda?
helena: NVIDIA 535.86 + CUDA 12.2 stack. their fleet saw higher tail-latency after a kernel update. they want a staged pin on marketplace images and a canary smoke
jess: marketplace constraints: pinned image build must pass vuln-scan and sign. canary plan: 5 hosts -> 50 hosts -> 500 hosts. each step waits 15m health window
vikram: add kernel-ABI probe before we apply pin; last time mismatch caused wedged nodes. also recommend collecting dmesg/journal logs during canary
omar: auto-rollback thresholds proposal: p95 latency +15% OR generation error-rate +0.5% OR any OOM. trigger rollback and notify #eng-oncall
ops-bot: saved policy: rollback_policy(conditions=[p95_latency:15%,error_rate:0.5%,oom_count:1],action=rollback_image)
jess: I'll create image job and attach the scan report. build will be tagged: marketplace-535.86-pin-4445556666
scan-bot: vulnerability scan required: queued job MQ-8891
helena: partner asked for a read-only telemetry export (sanitized) so they can correlate traces. security ok if PII and IPs masked and retention=48h
vikram: provide truncated stack traces and only the trace ids they request. prefer S3 prefix with time-limited credentials
omar: fallback routing: if node health < 0.92 OR tail latency > 160ms, route 100% traffic for affected routes to model-fallback-lowcap. I'll prepare a routing YAML snippet
helena: please include clear comms for customers: non-alarming, estimated maintenance window, contact points, automatic rollback guarantee. avoid public announcement unless 48h stable
jess: ops checklist draft:
- create pinned image tag
- run kernel-ABI probe on canary hosts
- deploy to canary group A (5 hosts)
- run smoke: kvcache, latency, e2e gen
- collect perf artifact and compare to baseline
- if green -> expand to group B (50 hosts)
- monitor 30m -> expand or rollback
- export sanitized telemetry to S3 (48h)
- post-run snapshot and logs to incident channel
helena: timeline: planning notes today, partner signoff by 18:00 PT, twilight window 23:45-00:30 PT, post-run snapshot by 04:00 PT
jess: creating incident channel: #ops-driver-pin-4445556666
ops-bot: channel created
vikram: partner rep will join 15m before start. they want the canary logs pasted into the incident channel in code blocks
omar: I'll add the routing override and the auto-fallback. also will instrument additional tail-latency traces for the run
helena: thanks. final ask: when build job starts, ping me and drop the image tag. i'll coordinate partner comms.
scan-bot: build job started: marketplace-535.86-pin-4445556666 [job: MB-4445]
jess: tagging ops checklist in channel now. please ack your availability
omar: available
vikram: available
helena: thanks all — will close thread when partner confirms and the job runs :white_check_mark:
